Name: Dax dog replacement sprite
Author: Pjlaan
Description:
Dax is our small rescue dog, and now also on our virtual farm.
Happy birthday Megan!


Install using Content Patcher (recommended method)
1) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2) Download the ZIP file and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
3) Run the game using SMAPI.
4) Now Dax is available as a Pet :)


Installation manually: (replaces default dog, outdated method, can cause issues)
Replace dog sprite:
1) navigate to your stardew valley installation
2) open content/animals
3) backup dog.xnb in a different folder
4) replace dog.xnb with the file provided in the mod page

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
